site_name: Flat 251 Manhattan Building, Bow Quarter, 60 Fairfield Road, London, E3 2UJ
description: Proposal involves internal, non structural alterations to create a more open plan layout within the bedroom to facilitate the installation of a new wardroble. All walls to be removed or constructed are non- load -bearing stud partitions, and no structural alterations are proposed. A detailed floor plan has been submitted as part of the application. The proposed works comprise of the following minor internal alterations:Removal of a stud wall: Demolition of an existing non-load-bearing stud partition within the bedroom, currently enclosing the wardrobe area.Relocation of the bedroom entrance: Infilling the existing doorway and forming a new entrance further along the same stud wall, utilising the existing hallway access.
